parameters.name: EnableEventLog
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the event history feature. Valid values:

*   **True**
*   **False**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-action-event-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --enable-event-log True --region cn-hangzhou
